mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmUnitpriceAlterHistoryPopList*/ SELECT A.PRICE_SEQ, --[01] A.ADD_DATE, --[02] A.TO_DATE, --[03] A.UNIT_PRICE, --[04] A.LIST_PRICE, --[05] DECODE(A.UNIT_PRICE,0,0,ROUND(((A.UNIT_PRICE - A.LIST_PRICE)/A.UNIT_PRICE)*100,2)) AS PRE_MARGIN, --[06] (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, --[07] DECODE(NVL(A.REMARK,'N'),'N','N','Y') REMARK_FLAG, --[08] A.AGENT, --[09] A.REMARK, --[10] (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME FROM ICOMCQEP A WHERE A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.CONTRACT_NO = #{contract_no} AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = #{contract_seq} AND A.STATUS != 'D' ORDER BY A.PRICE_SEQ

/*selectMasterMdCmUnitpriceAlterHistoryKMPopList*/ SELECT A.PRICE_SEQ, ADD_DATE, '' TO_DATE, A.BUY_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, A.SEL_PRICE AS LIST_PRICE, DECODE ( A.BUY_PRICE, 0, 0, ROUND ( ( (A.BUY_PRICE - A.SEL_PRICE) / A.BUY_PRICE) * 100, 2)) AS PRE_MARGIN, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, '' REMARK_FLAG, A.AGENT, '' REMARK, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME FROM XPROCQEP A WHERE A.STDCATLG_ID = #{buyer_item_no} AND A.LOCATION_NO != #{contract_seq} ORDER BY A.PRICE_SEQ
